This photo shows leftovers after a meal, so I estimated only what appears to remain.

- Muesli with yogurt in the bowl: about 40 g, roughly 80 kcal.
- Muffin remnants in the paper liner: about 15 g, roughly 60 kcal.
- Egg or scrambled-egg residue on the plate: about 10 g, roughly 20 kcal.
- Yogurt cup: it looks empty and adds almost nothing.
- Coffee with milk: about 200 g, roughly 40 kcal. I counted it because it is a food item, though it is not on a plate.
- Water: 0 kcal.

The question asks about food on the plate, so I left out the coffee. That gives about 65 g of food and about 160 kcal.
